observation.visible_scene: A white personal steam vaporizer/humidifier with a clear, perforated mask attachment angled upward sits on a wooden table in front of a window showing sunlit trees; closed white shutters and a gray wall fill the right background, and a small white appliance (grille/fan-like) is at the lower-left edge.
visible_changes: A plume of white vapor/steam is continuously emitted from the top opening of the mask attachment throughout the excerpt.
The rising steam is turbulent: its wisps swirl, thin out, and change shape and density from frame to frame as they drift upward past the shutters.
The vaporizer body, mask, table, background, and left appliance stay fixed in position; the device does not move.
No camera pan or zoom is evident; framing of the window and shutters is constant.
No onset or completion of the steam is shown; the emission is already ongoing at frame 1 and still ongoing at the last frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: When the device was switched on or whether it will be switched off after the clip.
What produces the vapor (water reservoir, heating element) and any unseen operator.
Events before the crop boundary and after the last frame.
uncertain_details: Exact brand/label text on the device is partially legible but not confirmed.
Minor lighting flicker on the table cannot be distinguished from steam shadowing.
Whether any imperceptible camera drift exists is uncertain given the static background.
